source.description: Deterministic orchestration scenario definitions for isolated V3.3 research workflow acceptance; contains no market data, model response or provider credentials

expectedAssertions.description: Two isolated deterministic research rounds settle exact costs and publish one immutable artifact per round.
A TestRun budget-cap rejection creates no Experiment, Runner Job, ledger mutation or downstream call.
Recovery resumes the same round from its persisted checkpoint under a new fence and rejects stale publication.
